The 2027 WestWyn 37R Fifth Wheel RV Is Built Different, and You Can Tell Right Away
18 photos
Photo: YouTube/Myles RVs
Even on a good, generous day, you will probably admit that many RVs tend to give off that feeling of "seen one, seen them all," with little to no variation, and sometimes zero creativity. If that's the case, Recreation by Design has heard all our complaints and come up with something entirely new.
Recreation by Design is a family-owned business with a long history in RV production, even though the name is not as familiar with wider audiences as established companies. Based out of Elkhart, IN, they do almost everything in-house, from the cabinetry to the heavy-duty steel frame on which they built their product, and that means full control over the final product.
With full control comes accountability. Recreation by Design promises "a better standard of building" for every unit that leaves their production line. They deliver by respecting three other promises: client first, timeless design, and quality construction.
All these things also apply to their first-ever fifth wheel RV . Earlier this year, Recreation by Design announced the WestWyn series of fifth wheelers that you might also find spelled online as West Wyn. As of this writing, it's comprised of just two floorplans, with the flagship being the 37R, or what I would dare describe as the perfect couple's RV.
Photo: Recreation by Design It's elegant, it's spacious and very well designed, it's high quality, and it's primed in every way for full-time, year-round living. The WestWyn 37R is a treat on the eye and promises to be an even bigger treat once you get to call one such unit your home on wheels.
Since we can't speak on the latter, we'll have to make do with the former. At the bottom of the page is an extended tour of the prototype for the 37R floorplan, as it was presented at a recent trade event. The full list of specs is still pending right now, and that includes pricing, weights, and other details.
But we do know this: the WestWyn 37R is a fifth wheel with three slide-outs, a tandem axle, and a distinct silhouette that only prefaces the distinctness you'll find inside. As the headline says, it's built different, and you can tell that even from a distance.
Photo: Recreation by Design This floorplan comes in at 39 feet (11.8 feet) of total length, with a pair of 7,000-lb axles with MORryde CRE3000 suspension and J-rated tires on 17.5-inch aluminum wheels. The chassis is built in house with steel, while the superstructure includes Azdel sidewalls, PVC roofing, and a front fiberglass front cap with automotive-grade painting.
A Gen-Y pinbox is included standard to offer ease of towing, while six-point hydraulic auto-leveling allow for a quick setup at camp . The RV comes with double-pane insulated windows with integrated blackouts, walkable slide tops, and a generously-sized pass-through storage compartment at the front that is accessible from three sides and various hatches.
Inside, the 37R lives like a real elegant apartment, with high-gloss upper cabinetry, Congoleum flooring in a stone look, residential furniture (chosen in stark black in the display unit to contrast nicely against the white cabinetry, and residential appliances.
Photo: Recreation by Design In general lines, the layout isn't novel. In fact, it's pretty common for a couple's fifth wheel, with a bedroom and bathroom on the upper deck, a kitchen in the central part of the trailer, and a rear living room. But where Recreation by Design changes things up is in the way they design, build, and style all these spaces.
Recreation by Design claims that these spaces are an example of their design language , and as vague as this is, it's an accurate description. Everything from the waterfall island with an integrated breakfast bar, the neat pantry that separates the living room from the kitchen space, the storage built around the sleeper sofa or the entertainment center, and the unique layout of the bedroom betrays a lot of attention to detail and a desire to offer maximum functionality and style.
The bedroom, for example, avoids the standard layout with a king bed in a slide and a wardrobe in the front cap. Instead, Recreation by Design puts a queen bed with the head inside the cap, adding a backlit headboard where the windshield would be.
Photo: Recreation by Design Then, they lower the bed more than you'd expect and rebuild and pad the frame, creating a very residential vibe. On the off-side, in a teeny-tiny slide-out , you get a full wardrobe with hinges that allow you to slide the doors without having them intrude into the living space. Leftover space is walkable floorspace, but you also get a closet with shelves and prep for a washer and dryer.
Every other space is just as smartly designed, even though the bedroom takes the cake in terms of creative thinking. The bathroom is spacious and specced with storage for all the essentials, offering a premium shower with a multi-head spray and an oversize skylight.
The kitchen is a full one, with a coffee hutch, a dedicated garbage chute, an island with a large sink and a dishwasher, and the main cooking block that leaves nothing to be desired. For larger or more formal diner parties when the breakfast bar wouldn't work, there's a standalone dinette with an adjustable table that also "turns" into a desk.
Photo: Recreation by Design The living room space features a convertible sofa , premium theater seats, an entertainment wall, and – again – ample storage and moving space. Using black upholstery and furniture for contrast in the display unit was a very smart choice.
The WestWyn 37R comes standard with a 35,000-BTU furnace, a Fogatti on-demand water heater, an 18,000-BTU Furrion Chill Cube with a heat pump in the living room, an 8,000-BTU Furrion AC in the bedroom, JBL audio inside and out, and a Winegard 360 antenna. You also get prep for 650W of solar, prep for a backup camera, and prep for Starlink.
Photo: Recreation by Design In terms of autonomy , this RV carries 71 gallons (268 liters) of fresh water, 90 gallons (340 liters) of gray, and 50 gallons (189 liters) of black water, and all tanks are heated. The WestWyn 37R has an enclosed and insulated underbelly, an undermounted spare tire with a winch crank-down, and 50-amp shore power connection.
As mentioned already, there's no official info regarding MSRP for the 2027 WestWyn 37R, but buzz online has it that sale prices will probably be between $90,000 and $105,000.
